title: Finch Circle Relationship Share on Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Line Reviews
content:
**Terms.** At a credit line review of a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the line-review increase percentage is the relationship share times the card's largest single credit line increase percent. A cardmember whose Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership is active at Finch Circle Platinum, Finch Circle Diamond or Finch Circle Icon and whose Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to the account with a transaction date fewer than 12 full calendar months before today total at least USD 1500.00 has the relationship share 1.0; a cardmember whose Finch Circle membership is active at Finch Circle Silver or Finch Circle Gold and whose such purchases total at least USD 600.00 has the relationship share 0.75; every other cardmember has the relationship share 0.5.

The records read are the cardmember's Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership (its tier and whether it is active) and the account's purchase postings at Marlowe & Finch by transaction date.

## Both conditions of each share

| Finch Circle membership, active at | Marlowe & Finch card purchases in the span | Relationship share |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Diamond or Icon | at least USD 1500.00 | 1.0 |
| Silver or Gold | at least USD 600.00 | 0.75 |
| any other case | — | 0.5 |

## Cases (hypothetical cardmembers)

| Membership | Purchases in the span | Share |
|---|---|---|
| active, Finch Circle Icon | USD 2000.00 | 1.0 |
| active, Finch Circle Diamond | USD 1499.99 | 0.5 (Diamond is not a Silver or Gold tier) |
| active, Finch Circle Gold | USD 600.00 | 0.75 |
| active, Finch Circle Gold | USD 4000.00 | 0.75 |
| active, Finch Circle Silver | USD 599.99 | 0.5 |
| active, Finch Circle Member | USD 5000.00 | 0.5 |
| Finch Circle Platinum, not active | USD 3000.00 | 0.5 |
| no Finch Circle membership | any | 0.5 |

On a card whose largest single increase percent is a hypothetical 40, a relationship share of 0.75 gives a line-review increase percentage of 30.
